title: Multilayer perceptrons: approximation, depth and width
summary: Affine maps composed with nonlinearities; the universal approximation theorem (statement, a constructive ReLU sketch, and what it does not say); classification with cross-entropy; the depth-versus-width trade-off at fixed parameter count; initialisation.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is W1D3 Tutorials 1 (Biological vs. Artificial Neural Networks) and 2 (Deep MLPs) of the Neuromatch Deep Learning ebook.

preparation.description: Read W1D3 Tutorial 1 (universal approximation with ReLU, MLPs in PyTorch, cross entropy, train/eval and the generalisation question) and Tutorial 2 (wide versus deep, a real-world dataloader, initialisation bonus).
